text:
v1.15.42 — an agent sweep over the tree, every claim measured before it was believed. Seventeen claims held. The headline: POST /api/restore with a users list whose every row was unusable answered 200 {"ok": true, "added_users": 0} and left the customer table empty — the guard tested data.users while the wipe depended on prepared_users. Also fixed: a validator that caught one spelling of a field and not the other, two serialisers that 500 the whole list on a bytes or NULL column, a missing index that made every subscription lookup a table scan, and an access log that wrote customers' account tokens to the journal on every poll. 42 suites A second suite came out of the same sweep and guards a defect that was mine rather than the panel's: the index helper was spliced in between @staticmethod and def _add_column, so database.py PARSED while every migration raised TypeError on the first step and _index was a NameError at the point the list is built. ast.parse proves syntax and never names, which is why migration_run_test.py now builds a real Database, drops the index to look upgraded, and runs all 26 steps..
v1.15.41 — the installer the README told you to trust was 24 releases out of date, and the check that should have noticed had frozen to the same number. All four READMEs pinned the read-it-first path at v1.15.16 while the panel shipped 1.15.40. Also: the four BackPack tunnel options from v1.15.37 were documented in no language, the Developer API section and the menu layout controls were in the panel and in no README, a sample run line said 37/37 suites against 40, the repo About claimed a 117-check suite, the landing page still said Sep 13, and the screenshots were three weeks old. All refreshed, in four languages.
v1.15.40 - three defects in the release notes themselves, and the guard that missed all three. The v1.15.39 heading displayed v1.15.38 - the only duplicated version number in 41 headings, and the newest one. The changelog was not in version order: eleven inversions, the 1.15.28 to 1.15.39 block ran ascending and the shipped release sat 12th of 41, because the cut script anchored on a hardcoded id that was the newest only when it was written. And site-knowledge.json shipped with ten U+FFFD in the site assistant's own text, seven of them already committed. The guard read the h2 id, never the label, and called every locale non-empty rather than decodable. Also: ai_url_guard_test.py, 16 checks, 3 mutations.
v1.15.39 - the first-run banner printed "(mode 600)" whether or not the chmod had succeeded. On a filesystem that refuses it the credentials file keeps the umask's bits - 0644 on a default Linux umask, readable by every local user - while the operator was told it was private. It is now reported honestly, and a failure tells the operator the exact chmod to run.
Latest releases:

v1.15.38 - the pre-update snapshot has never run. main.py used INSTANCE_DIR without importing it, so both updater helpers died on their first line with NameError, and _snapshot_runtime_state swallowed it in an `except Exception` and logged a warning that reads like a disk problem. _do_update runs that call and `git reset --hard` one line apart, so the reset was proceeding with no copy of the master key, CA or database. The test that should have caught it only checked the function's name was in the source.

The test that should have caught it only checked the function's name was in the source.
v1.15.37 - BackPack had shipped v1.8.3, v1.8.4 and v1.8.5 while the panel was still pinned to v1.8.2, and the tunnel setup guide described the wizard those releases retired. The pin moves to v1.8.5, the guide is rewritten around the setup link, and four capabilities upstream added become real panel options: a per-tunnel traffic cap, a restart schedule for both ends, backup addresses in the link, and a choice of performance preset. Plus the SNI Spoofing carrier.
v1.15.37 - BackPack had shipped v1.8.3, v1.8.4 and v1.8.5 while the panel was still pinned to v1.8.2, and the tunnel setup guide described the wizard those releases retired. The pin moves to v1.8.5, the guide is rewritten around the setup link, and four capabilities upstream added become real panel options: a per-tunnel traffic cap, a restart schedule for both ends, backup addresses in the link, and a choice of performance preset. Plus the SNI Spoofing carrier.
v1.15.36 - /api/update/status held its request for 12 seconds whenever the link to GitHub was slow, because the route made up to three 10-second calls inline and the panel is single-worker. The GitHub half now lives on a daemon thread behind a 60-second cache: 12.00 s before, 0.23 s cold and 0.025 s warm after, measured on a live panel.
v1.15.35 - the API reference documented 33 of the panel's 67 routes. All 33 are now written, in four languages, and a new guard parses main.py the way FastAPI registers it so a route added without documentation fails the suite instead of reaching a reader. Comparing the four READMEs to the runner turned up seven more stale claims, all now taken from the runner instead of typed.
v1.15.34 - the three node routes that disclose a secret or probe a node wrote no log line at all. They are audited, so the audit log answers who did it, but nothing answered when, from where, or whether the node actually responded - which is what you need when a fleet misbehaves in production.
v1.15.33 - the single-worker rule is enforced rather than advised: the panel reads WEB_CONCURRENCY at startup and refuses to start above one worker, naming what breaks, because documentation had not stopped anyone from quadruplicating the rate-limit budgets. Requests now carry an X-Request-Id that is echoed, validated and logged with the status and duration.
v1.15.32 - documentation brought back in line with the code. The README claimed 62 API routes across 10 panel sections and listed nine test suites; it is 67 routes, 11 sections and 35 suites, and the suite list is now generated from the runner so it cannot drift again. The docs' security page gained the section on what is encrypted, which v1.15.27 and v1.15.29 made out of date.
v1.15.31 - the README still claimed the per-customer credentials were stored as plain JSON, which stopped being true in v1.15.27, and listed no database other than SQLite although DATABASE_URL has always accepted PostgreSQL and MySQL. SECURITY.md also said seven test suites where there are thirty-five, and the AI assistant's data exposure is now written down rather than left unstated.
v1.15.30 - SECURITY.md corrected. It still said the per-customer credentials were stored as plain JSON, which stopped being true in v1.15.27, and it listed a WireGuard host private key among the encrypted items even though the panel never stores one.
v1.15.29 - the subscription bearer token is encrypted at rest. A token copied out of the database file used to answer /sub/{token} with 200 and the customer's WireGuard private key, with no credentials of any kind, and an unencrypted backup carried the same token in cleartext - so one stolen file handed over every customer at once. Existing panels are upgraded in place and nobody's subscription URL changes.
v1.15.28 - secret disclosure had no rate limit: the node guide and the customer config download answered 200 thirty times in a row while the route one line away was budgeted at ten; an empty API-token scope now denies instead of granting full access, and the bot token can no longer reach the journal through an exception.
v1.15.27 - customer credentials held in the panel are now encrypted at rest: reading the database file or an unencrypted backup no longer hands over working WireGuard/OpenVPN/L2TP secrets, the AI key, the Telegram bot token or the REALITY private key. Existing installs are upgraded in place and older plaintext rows still load. The docs now carry a Roadmap page, in all four languages.
v1.15.26 - the installer no longer executes its own comments as root, and a panel that is not answering no longer prints a green "Installed." banner.
v1.15.25 - the settings section is grouped by subject (Core, Network & TLS, Assistant/Data & Activity); the backup file now states that the admin hashes and API tokens it carries are never imported by restore.
v1.15.23 - an empty restore is refused instead of deleting every customer; the
  pre-restore safety copy now logs when it fails instead of failing silently.
v1.15.22 - the settings port check rejected only non-numbers, so 0 or 70000
  discarded the whole save; a failed check no longer ships a WireGuard config
  with no server key.
v1.15.21 - the documented least-privilege `bot` token scope was unreachable from
  the panel, so every token was a full credential; 21 audit events had no label
  and showed as raw constants.
v1.15.20 - Telegram's one "chat not found" message now says which of the four
  different causes it actually was.
v1.15.16 - the README's numbers had drifted from the code.
v1.15.15 - the `.env` backup was briefly world-readable.
v1.15.13 - one backslash in the version corrupted every asset URL on the site.
v1.15.12 - the installer appended its SSL block through a symlink, as root.
v1.15.11 - one failed migration step could roll back every step before it.
v1.15.10 - the customer list handed out 500 live credentials per call, unbounded;
  the database password was passed in argv and was world-readable in /proc.
v1.15.9 - the updater refused every update since v1.0.0 because it matched
  `.env` as a prefix and every release ships an `.env.example`.
v1.15.7 - a customer's subscription served 91 unparseable lines around one link.
v1.15.4 - an unconfigured reverse proxy locked the operator out of login.
Full history on the changelog page.

title: Tunnels and server nodes

text: BackPack tunnels (Iran⇄Kharej): create node in Tunnels, run the same token on both servers (Setup Iran / Setup Kharej), verify with Check-now. Server Nodes: register remotes for 5-min health checks; pin inbounds to a node — offline nodes drop out of links automatically. Anti-filter stack: REALITY keys + SNI rotation + obfuscated host + per-user subdomains + CDN SNI. BackPack v1.8.2 adds: plain UDP transport, Direct mode (Iran dials out, no inbound port needed — pick Direct + carrier in the wizard), Link Test transport recommendations, WSS certificate support.
fa: تانل BackPack ‏(ایران⇄خارج)‏: در تانل‌ها نود بساز، همان توکن را در هر دو سرور اجرا کن (Setup Iran / Setup Kharej)، با Check-now تأیید کن. نودهای سرور: ثبت ریموت‌ها برای health-check هر 5 دقیقه؛ اینباند را به نود پین کن — نود آفلاین خودکار از لینک‌ها می‌افتد. استک ضدفیلتر: کلیدهای REALITY + چرخش SNI + هاست مبهم + ساب‌دامنه هر کاربر + جعل SNI با CDN. در BackPack v1.8.2: transport ساده UDP، حالت Direct (ایران dial-out می‌کند و inbound لازم نیست — در ویزارد Direct + carrier را انتخاب کن)، پیشنهاد transport با Link Test، پشتیبانی گواهی برای WSS.
zh: BackPack 隧道（伊朗⇄境外）：在隧道页建节点，两台服务器用同一令牌运行（Setup Iran / Setup Kharej），用 Check-now 验证。服务器节点：注册远端做 5 分钟健康检查；把入站绑定到节点——离线节点自动从链接中剔除。反过滤组合：REALITY 密钥 + SNI 轮换 + 混淆主机 + 每用户子域名 + CDN SNI 伪装。BackPack v1.8.2 新增：纯 UDP 传输、Direct 模式（伊朗主动外拨、无需入站端口——在向导里选 Direct + carrier）、Link Test 传输推荐、WSS 证书支持。
ru: Туннели BackPack (Иран⇄Харедж): создай ноду в Туннелях, прогони тот же токен на обоих серверах (Setup Iran / Setup Kharej), проверь Check-now. Серверные ноды: регистрация удалённых для health-check каждые 5 минут; привяжи инбаунд к ноде — офлайн-ноды сами выпадают из ссылок. Антифильтр-стек: ключи REALITY + ротация SNI + обфусцированный хост + per-user поддомены + CDN SNI. В BackPack v1.8.2: обычный UDP-транспорт, режим Direct (Иран звонит наружу, входящий порт не нужен — выбери Direct + carrier в визарде), рекомендации транспорта через Link Test, поддержка сертификатов для WSS.

title: Updates and backup
keywords: update upgrade version backup restore encrypted download import export آپدیت بکاپ ریستور
text: Update (left menu): compares with GitHub, shows incoming changes, password-confirmed pull + reinstall + restart; refused on local changes. Backup: password-confirmed download, encrypted option available; restore wipes users — both need the password.
fa: آپدیت (منوی چپ): با گیت‌هاب مقایسه می‌کند، تغییرات ورودی را نشان می‌دهد، با تأیید پسورد پول + نصب مجدد + ری‌استارت؛ با تغییر محلی رد می‌شود. بکاپ: دانلود با تأیید پسورد، گزینه رمزنگاری؛ برگرداندن کاربران را پاک می‌کند — هر دو پسورد می‌خواهند.
zh: 更新（左侧菜单）：与 GitHub 对比、展示 incoming 变更，密码确认后拉取 + 重装 + 重启；有本地改动则拒绝。备份：密码确认下载，可加密；恢复会清空用户——两者都要密码。
ru: Обновление (левое меню): сравнение с GitHub, показ входящих изменений, pull + переустановка + рестарт по паролю; при локальных правках — отказ. Бэкап: скачивание по паролю, есть шифрование; восстановление стирает юзеров — везде нужен пароль.

title: Top problems
keywords: problem error fail login lockout locked 404 ssl password lost down troubleshoot fix help مشکل خطا ورود قفل
text: Locked out (too many attempts)? Wait 15 min or restart the panel. Sub 404 for everyone? Check expiry/volume/active, then domain/ports, then firewall. SSL fails? DNS must point here + port 80 free + certbot. Clients can't connect but sub loads? Server ports or REALITY/WireGuard keys. Lost password? Only via fresh DB + backup restore.
fa: Lockout شدی (تلاش زیاد)؟ 15 دقیقه صبر کن یا پنل را ری‌استارت کن. ساب همه 404؟ اول انقضا/حجم/فعال، بعد دامنه/پورت، بعد فایروال. ‏SSL‏ خراب؟ ‏DNS‏ باید به اینجا اشاره کند + پورت 80 آزاد + ‏certbot‏. ساب لود می‌شود ولی کلاینت وصل نمی‌شود؟ پورت‌های سرور یا کلیدهای ‏REALITY/WireGuard‏. پسورد گم شد؟ فقط دیتابیس تازه + برگرداندن بکاپ.
zh: 被锁定（尝试过多）？等 15 分钟或重启面板。所有订阅 404？先查过期/流量/状态，再查域名/端口，再查防火墙。SSL 失败？DNS 必须指向本机 + 80 端口空闲 + 装好 certbot。订阅能加载但连不上？服务器端口或 REALITY/WireGuard 密钥。忘记密码？只能全新数据库 + 恢复备份。
ru: Локаут (много попыток)? Подожди 15 минут или рестартни панель. Сабы 404 у всех? Сначала expiry/трафик/статус, потом домен/порты, потом фаервол. SSL падает? DNS должен смотреть сюда + порт 80 свободен + certbot. Саб грузится, а клиенты нет? Порты сервера или ключи REALITY/WireGuard. Потерял пароль? Только свежая БД + восстановление из бэкапа.

title: Where to get help
keywords: support help contact ask question community human پشتیبانی کمک تماس سوال
text: Fastest channels: FAQ first, then GitHub Discussions (usage), Issues (bugs with repro steps), Security Advisories (private vuln reports). Before asking: panel version, journalctl -u zefira lines, what you tried. Never post tokens, passwords, backups or secret.key.
fa: اول FAQ، بعد Discussions (سوال)، Issues (باگ با steps)، آسیب‌پذیری فقط خصوصی. توکن/پسورد/بکاپ را هیچ‌جا پست نکن.
zh: 先看 FAQ,再去 Discussions(使用)、Issues(Bug 需复现步骤),漏洞只私下报告。别发令牌/密码/备份。
ru: Сначала FAQ, потом Discussions (вопросы), Issues (баги с шагами), уязвимости — только приватно. Токены/пароли/бэкапы не пости.
